headline: FPL Gameweek 8: Saka Replacements, Transfers & Captaincy
body: A week ago, the hardest question for most Fantasy Premier League managers was which Arsenal defenders to double up on. Now it's how many midfielders you can replace with the transfers you've got. This past week, we've seen Bukayo Saka get substituted early away at Bayern Munich. Antoine Semenyo is out for roughly 8 weeks with an injury he picked up over the weekend. Dominik Szoboszlai's hamstring went again after half an hour at Brentford. So the focus for Gameweek 8: Who's out, who comes in, who to captain, and where the next best fixture run lies. FPL Gameweek 8 Injury News And Transfer Decisions We are still waiting for the Friday pressers. But currently, this is where we stand: Bukayo Saka (£9.6m): Quad Injury And FPL Sell Verdict Saka lasted ten minutes in Munich on Wednesday night before pulling up with a quad injury. Mikel Arteta's words post-match were also not encouraging: "It doesn't look good at all, but we have to wait and see." We can expect Saka to be out for GW8 at the very least. Losing him means losing 3.62 xG, 4.82 xGI and 37 points from seven matches. Verdict: Sell. Antoine Semenyo (£8.3m): Knee Injury And FPL Sell Verdict Antoine Semenyo hurt his knee in the Gameweek 7 win over Ipswich Town. Enzo Maresca said the scan was better than first feared, but it still points to around 8 weeks out. Verdict: Sell. Dominik Szoboszlai (£6.8m): Hamstring Injury And FPL Sell Verdict Dominik Szoboszlai missed Gameweek 6 with a hamstring problem, returned to start at Brentford, and lasted half an hour before the same issue flared up again. Verdict: Sell. Erling Haaland (£15.7m): Fit For Aston Villa Erling Haaland limped off after the GW7 win over Ipswich Town, but made the bench for Manchester City's midweek win over AEK Athens. And since then, Enzo Maresca has indicated that he is "100% available" for Saturday's match away at Aston Villa. Verdict: Keep. Morgan Gibbs-White (£7.9m): Available For Ipswich Tow
